sections.title: Taxes and charges in Slovenia: the complete list

rows.label: Personal income tax (dohodnina) [national]
rows.value: Five bands from 16% to 50% on the annual net tax base; general allowance and personal allowances. Paid by residents on worldwide income, non-residents on Slovenian income. Zakon o dohodnini (ZDoh-2).
rows.note: Checklist item A1

source.title: FURS (Finančna uprava RS): Obvestilo o lestvici za odmero dohodnine in olajšave za leto 2026 (dated 15. 12. 2025)

rows.label: Capital gains tax for individuals (dohodnina od dobička iz kapitala) [national]
rows.value: 25%, falling to 20% after 5 years and 15% after 10 years of holding; real estate exempt after 15 years. Paid by individuals selling real estate, shares and other capital. ZDoh-2.
rows.note: Checklist item A5; detailed table: capital-income

source.title: FURS: Obresti, dividende in dobiček iz kapitala

rows.label: Withholding on dividends, interest and royalties (davčni odtegljaj) [national]
rows.value: Individuals: dividends and interest 25% final (deposit interest above €1,000 a year). Non-resident companies: 15% on interest and royalties; dividends exempt under conditions. Paid by the payer withholds it. ZDoh-2; ZDDPO-2.
rows.note: Checklist item A6; detailed table: capital-income

source.title: FURS: Obresti, dividende in dobiček iz kapitala

rows.label: Rental income (dohodek iz oddajanja premoženja v najem) [national]
rows.value: 25% final (schedular) tax on rent less 10% deemed costs (or actual maintenance costs); royalties from property rights 25%. Paid by landlords. ZDoh-2.
rows.note: Checklist item A7; detailed table: capital-income

source.title: FURS: Dohodek iz oddajanja premoženja v najem in iz prenosa premoženjske pravice

rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income (dohodnina nerezidentov od dohodka iz zaposlitve) [national]
rows.value: The advance income tax on pay is the final tax (no annual assessment); resident with permanent residence, habitual abode or centre of interests in Slovenia, or more than 183 days in the tax year. Paid by non-resident employees (advance tax withheld by the payer). ZDoh-2.
rows.note: Checklist item A8; detailed table: non-resident

source.title: FURS: Brošura: Mednarodna obdavčitev posameznikov

rows.label: Social security contributions (prispevki za socialno varnost) [national]
rows.value: Employee 22.1% and employer 16.1% (pension, health, parental, unemployment, injury) plus 1% long-term care each; compulsory health contribution (OZP) flat amount. Paid by employees and employers. Zakon o prispevkih za socialno varnost (ZPSV); ZDOsk-1.
rows.note: Checklist item B1

source.title: FURS: Dohodek iz drugega pogodbenega razmerja

rows.value: Insured and employer shares on a base between 60% and 3.5× the average wage a month. Paid by self-employed (s.p.). ZPSV.

rows.value: The payer withholds 25% advance income tax on the fee less contributions and 10% deemed costs; where the relationship has all elements of employment it is taxed as employment. Paid by payers of contract-work fees. ZDoh-2 art. 41 and 127; ZDR-1.

source.title: FURS: Dohodek iz drugega pogodbenega razmerja

rows.note: Checklist item C1; detailed table: corporate-tax

rows.value: Banks 0.2% of the balance-sheet total; solidarity contribution 80% of profit above 120% of the four-year average. Paid by banks and savings banks; companies with excess profit. ZDBVB; ZNPOVCE.

rows.label: Tourist tax and promotional tax (turistična taksa, promocijska taksa) [municipal]
rows.value: Set by each municipality at up to EUR 2.50 per person per night, plus a promotional tax of 25% of the tourist tax; the government may index the cap once a year, by April, for the next calendar year. rows.label: Personal income tax (dohodnina) [national]

rows.value: 25%, falling to 20% after 5 years and 15% after 10 years of holding; real estate exempt after 15 years. Paid by individuals selling real estate, shares and other capital. ZDoh-2.

rows.value: Individuals: dividends and interest 25% final (deposit interest above €1,000 a year). Non-resident companies: 15% on interest and royalties; dividends exempt under conditions. Paid by the payer withholds it. ZDoh-2; ZDDPO-2.

rows.value: The advance income tax on pay is the final tax (no annual assessment); resident with permanent residence, habitual abode or centre of interests in Slovenia, or more than 183 days in the tax year. Paid by non-resident employees (advance tax withheld by the payer). ZDoh-2.

rows.source_title: EUR-Lex: Council Directive 2007/74/EC on the exemption from value added tax and excise duty of goods imported by persons travelling from third countries, Articles 7 to 11
rows.label: Customs, import VAT and traveller allowances (carina, DDV pri uvozu) [EU]
rows.value: EU Common Customs Tariff; EUR 150 duty relief until 30 June 2026, then EUR 3 per item; 22% import VAT; EUR 430 / 300 traveller allowance; EUR 10,000 cash declaration. Paid by importers and travellers. Regulations (EC) 1186/2009, (EU) 2026/382 and 2018/1672; Directive 2007/74/EC.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovenia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item H3
rows.source_title: GOV.SI (Ministry of the Interior): Temporary residence permit for digital nomads (21. 11. 2025)
rows.label: Digital-nomad permit and new residents (expat regime) (dovoljenje za začasno prebivanje za digitalnega nomada) [national]
rows.value: No special tax regime: ordinary residence rules; no inbound or expat regime. Paid by non-EU remote workers. Zakon o tujcih; ZDoh-2.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovenia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item A2
rows.source_title: FURS (Finančna uprava RS): Dodatni davek od dohodkov članov poslovodstev in nadzornih organov v času finančne in gospodarske krize (refreshed 28 March 2025)
rows.label: Surcharge on income tax: supplementary tax on management income in state-aided companies (dodatni davek od dohodkov članov poslovodstev in nadzornih organov) [national]
rows.value: Charged on the income of management and supervisory board members of legal persons that received state guarantees or crisis funds; paid on income received up to 31 December 2010 and still applied to related income received after the guarantees or measures expire (rate not stated on the FURS page). Paid by members of management and supervisory boards of state-aided legal persons. Zakon o dodatnem davku od dohodkov članov poslovodstev in nadzornih organov v času finančne in gospodarske krize (ZDDČPNO).

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovenia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item A3
rows.source_title: GOV.SI (Ministrstvo za finance): Financiranje občin (last changed 11 November 2026)
rows.label: Regional or municipal income tax: none [municipal]
rows.value: None: municipalities levy no income tax; their largest own resource is a 54% share of the personal income tax (dohodnina) collected two years earlier. Paid by no one. Zakon o financiranju občin (ZFO-1).

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovenia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item A4
rows.source_title: GOV.SI (Finančna uprava RS): Do konca leta se lahko namenite del dohodnine za donacije za leto 2025 (last changed 8 December 2025)
rows.label: Church tax: none (income tax donation instead) [national]
rows.value: None: taxpayers may ask for up to 1% of their personal income tax to go to listed beneficiaries, including registered churches and other religious communities. Paid by no one. Zakon o dohodnini (namenitev dela dohodnine za donacije).

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovenia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item B4
rows.source_title: GOV.SI: Poklicno zavarovanje (last changed 16 October 2026)
rows.label: Occupational pension insurance, compulsory for listed hazardous jobs (poklicno zavarovanje) [national]
rows.value: Employer contribution of 9.25% of the occupational insurance base for posts covered by article 413 ZPIZ-2; from 1 January 2026 to 31 December 2027: 8.9% (groups 1 and 2), 9.15% (group 3) and 9.6% (groups 4 and 5). Paid by employers, and self-employed persons whose employees work in those posts. Zakon o pokojninskem in invalidskem zavarovanju (ZPIZ-2), article 413; occupational insurance pension plan.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovenia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item C2
rows.source_title: GOV.SI (Ministrstvo za finance): Financiranje občin (last changed 11 November 2026)
rows.label: Local business tax: none [municipal]
rows.value: None: municipal own resources are the income tax share, the building land use charge (NUSZ), property and other listed taxes, the tourist tax, municipal fees (občinske takse), administrative fees and charges; there is no municipal tax on business profits or turnover. Paid by no one. Zakon o financiranju občin (ZFO-1).

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovenia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item D2
rows.source_title: GOV.SI (Ministrstvo za finance): Financiranje občin (last changed 11 November 2026)
rows.label: Regional or municipal sales tax: none [municipal]
rows.value: None: no sales or consumption tax is among the municipalities' own resources; VAT is a national tax. Paid by no one. Zakon o financiranju občin (ZFO-1).

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovenia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item D5
rows.source_title: FURS: Brošura o davku na dobitke pri klasičnih igrah na srečo (1st edition, March 2015), linked from the FURS page on the tax (refreshed 4 April 2025)
rows.label: Gambling tax: tax on winnings from classic games of chance (davek na dobitke pri klasičnih igrah na srečo) [national]
rows.value: 15% of each winning of EUR 300 or more from classic games of chance; winnings below EUR 300 are not taxed. Paid by winners. Zakon o davku na dobitke pri klasičnih igrah na srečo (ZDDKIS).

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovenia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item F3
rows.source_title: PISRS: Zakon o spodbujanju razvoja turizma (ZSRT-1), neuradno prečiščeno besedilo št. 1 (ZSRT-1, Uradni list RS 13/18, and ZSRT-1A, Uradni list RS 100/25), applicable from 19 December 2025, article 17
rows.label: Tourist tax and promotional tax (turistična taksa, promocijska taksa) [municipal]
rows.value: Set by each municipality at up to EUR 2.50 per person per night, plus a promotional tax of 25% of the tourist tax; the government may index the cap once a year, by April, for the next calendar year. Paid by Slovenian citizens and foreigners staying overnight in accommodation; owners of holiday homes and of boats on permanent berths. Zakon o spodbujanju razvoja turizma (ZSRT-1), article 17.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovenia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item F4
rows.source_title: FURS (Finančna uprava RS): Področja – the taxes, contributions, excise duties, environmental levies and customs it administers
rows.label: Departure or air passenger tax: none [national]
rows.value: None: no departure or air passenger tax is among the taxes and charges administered by the Financial Administration. Paid by no one. FURS, Področja.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovenia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item H1
rows.source_title: GOV.SI (Ministry responsible for public administration): Taksna tarifa – priloga Zakona o upravnih taksah, linked from the 'Upravne takse' page (last changed 18 June 2026)
rows.label: Administrative fees (upravne takse) [national]
rows.value: Fixed fees under the tariff: EUR 4.50 per application (no fee for electronic applications), EUR 18.10 per appeal and per decision, EUR 3.00 or EUR 4.50 per certificate. Paid by applicants. Zakon o upravnih taksah (ZUT), taksna tarifa.
